appliedUpdates.description: Dispatcher catch-all arm: dispatcher.rs has a catch-all match arm `[_, 0xBF] => IncomingMessage::Ready` that matches any first byte with second byte 0xBF. Workers writing dispatcher tests for message types must use a second byte != 0xBF to actually test the Unknown path. Using [0x7E, 0xBF] will dispatch as Ready, not Unknown.

rejectedObservations.observation: FilterCycle parsing uses raw u8 for duration_hours and start_hour without range validation. Values like duration_hours=25 or start_hour=127 are stored as-is without clamping.
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented — architecture.md already describes the protocol parser as a thin wire-format decoder; this is implicit in the existing documentation
